articles.title: COINBASE ROLLS OUT DERIVATIVES FOR UK PROFESSIONAL INVESTORS
articles.summary: Coinbase is progressively rolling out perpetuals, dated futures, and crypto options to eligible UK professional clients following its recently secured MiFID license. The offerings cover 170+ contracts across crypto, commodities, equities, and FX, with perpetuals available 24/7 at up to 50x leverage and dated futures up to 20x. It's the latest addition to Coinbase's "Everything Exchange" push in the UK.

articles.title: FLIGHTAWARE SUES KALSHI OVER ALLEGED UNAUTHORIZED DATA USE
articles.summary: FlightAware sued Kalshi Monday, alleging Kalshi built flight-cancellation betting markets on FlightAware's data without authorization while implying a close partnership, damaging its reputation. FlightAware is seeking a temporary restraining order and injunctions, citing breach of contract, trademark infringement, and unfair competition, plus safety concerns that the markets could incentivize unsafe tactics to trigger cancellations. This adds to Kalshi's mounting legal fights, including active lawsuits or injunctions from New York, Washington, and Michigan over sports-event contracts, while the CFTC has sued several states to assert federal jurisdiction.

articles.title: ETHEREUM STRAWMAP 2026 UPDATE: QUANTUM SAFETY, PRIVACY, ZKZK FRAMES
articles.summary: Vitalik Buterin updated Ethereum's 2026 Strawmap with seven categories absent from the 2023 roadmap, including native rollups enabled by SNARK maturity, blob and gas futures, and zkzk frames that would expose a non-EVM ISA (leading candidates: leanISA and RISC-V) at the protocol level, with the EVM becoming an intermediate representation on top rather than an enshrined feature. Quantum safety was elevated to a first-class priority, backed by leanSPHINCS signatures and post-quantum aggregation, while privacy received protocol-level treatment via keyed nonces, recent roots, FOCIL components, lean privacy pools, and wormholes. Recursive STARKs now span the execution, consensus, and data layers through a shared "aggregate to union verified dependencies" primitive, with full formal verification of the lean spec made tractable by modern AI tooling. VDFs and many EVM improvements were deprioritized, and state expiry was replaced by new state types offering specialized, scaling-friendly mechanisms for high-volume use cases such as token transfers, swaps, and privacy protocols.

articles.title: EIP-8363: THE UNMEASURED COST TO ONCHAIN CREDIT
articles.summary: EIP-8363 tapers consensus rewards to zero net issuance at 60.25M ETH staked (~half the supply), cutting total validator income ~50% at current stake levels, while leaving MEV untouched, which increases its share of validator revenue and strengthens incentives for aggressive extraction. The EIP's own authors acknowledge that LST looping drives most ETH lending yield, yet neither the proposal nor its cited research models the credit markets priced off the staking rate, where compressed spreads would cause borrowers to repay WETH debt, reduce lending utilization, and push deposit APY down faster than staking yield itself. With LSTs comprising ~40% of all onchain TVL, $2.6B in stablecoin debt collateralized by ETH/LST, and $11.4B in ETF and treasury inflows holding 7.8M ETH on corporate balance sheets, the taper puts a large portion of Ethereum's TVL lead at risk without modeled justification. Ship MEV burn first and model staking-yield-dependent lending markets before revisiting issuance. Post-Merge net ETH issuance already runs at 0.30%/year, below BTC (0.82%), gold (1.7%), and M2 expansion (5.5%).

articles.title: ROBINHOOD CHAIN: CAN IT MOVE ROBINHOOD'S BOTTOM LINE?
articles.summary: Robinhood's Q2 2026 crypto revenue fell 38% YoY to $100M, dropping to 8% of total revenue and an all-time low 7% share of AUC, as retail crypto volume hit its lowest level since Q3 2024 and institutional Bitstamp volume surpassed retail for the first time. Robinhood Chain launched July 1 and led all L2s tracked by growthepie in its first month with $3.6M in REV, outpacing Polygon and Base, though memecoins drove 51% of on-chain spot volume while RWAs accounted for just 5%. Known annualized chain revenue totals roughly $54.8M ($43.2M REV, $10.5M from USDG yield on $333.1M market cap, plus a Lighter perps share), about 14% of Robinhood's $400M annualized crypto revenue, leaving the chain immaterial to the bottom line. Morpho, integrated into the main Robinhood app, reached the chain's 3rd-largest TVL deployment within one month, while Lighter's wallet-only perps integration attracted just 0.2% of its volume despite $25M in LIT token incentives, indicating that main-app distribution is the variable that determines whether chain activity scales.

articles.title: 5 CHARTS: HOW CRYPTO CARDS ARE DRIVING STABLECOIN SPEND
articles.summary: Crypto payment card volume reached $759 million in July, up 2.5x year-over-year from $306 million and from sub-$1 million at tracking inception in October 2023, across nearly 9 million transactions averaging $86 each, per Paymentscan. Settlement now concentrates on Optimism (29%), Solana (19%), and Base (19%), while Gnosis has dropped to roughly 2% after previously dominating as the home of Gnosis Pay. Dollar-backed stablecoins have displaced euro alternatives: USDC handles 58% of card spend and USDT 26%, compared to 48% and 7% a year ago respectively, while EURe's share collapsed from 88% in early 2024 to about 2% today. Cards convert stablecoins to local fiat at point of sale via Visa rails, allowing holders to access dollar accounts without a traditional bank account, though the category's monthly volume remains orders of magnitude below the trillions processed by legacy card networks.

articles.title: WHAT MASTERCARD ACTUALLY BOUGHT IN BVNK
articles.summary: On-chain analysis of Mastercard's $1.8B BVNK acquisition (closed August 3) shows $32.9 billion in cumulative on-chain flow since October 2024, with trailing-twelve-month volume of $23 billion against $30 billion in reported annualized volume, close enough to suggest most flow is real settlement. However, growth has plateaued as although Q1 2026 volume was 2.6x the prior year, Q2 fell to 1.6x and dipped below Q1 in absolute terms, with monthly flow peaking at $2.37 billion in March and holding near $1.9 billion since. Ethereum now carries 62% of monthly flow versus Tron, while Base and Arbitrum combined account for just 0.6% of all volume BVNK has ever moved, despite two years of L2 payment narratives.

articles.title: EXPLORING THE OUTLOOK FOR BITCOIN
articles.summary: Bitcoin ETFs have logged net $5B in outflows over 52 weeks while the DRAM memory ETF pulled $10B in a single month, quantifying the demand deficit that has pinned BTC below its 200-week EMA and around the 2021 ATH. On-chain and derivatives metrics cluster in deep-value territory: MVRV is at accumulation-zone levels, spot turnover relative to market cap sits at all-time lows, front-end implied volatility is at multi-year lows, and BTC futures basis cannot clear T-bill yield parity. The DAT supply overhang that pressured price through late 2024 and into 2025 is unwinding as treasury companies slow or reverse BTC accumulation, while long-term holders absorb supply aggressively. Recovery is a seller exhaustion event rather than a demand-led rally. Large asset manager portfolio allocations are the primary upside catalyst. DCA spot or buy cheap implied volatility via options over the coming months.

articles.title: ANOTHER DORMANT BITCOIN WALLET HOLDING MILLIONS WAKES UP AFTER 12 YEARS
articles.summary: A Bitcoin address dormant since January 2014 moved 26.96 BTC valued at approximately $1.75 million on August 10, generating a 7,975% realized gain on coins originally acquired at roughly $803 per BTC.
